articles.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
articles.snippet: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

articles.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

articles.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
articles.snippet: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.

articles.title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
articles.snippet: While Tether's stated ceiling places its maximum exposure under $64 million, the incident underscores lingering counterparty risks in fiat gateway networks.

articles.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
articles.snippet: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.
